name: io.github.noddle-dev/noddle-draw
title: noddle draw
description: Read, create and edit open-source noddle draw diagram boards, browse versions and comment.

environmentVariables.name: NODDLE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: http(s) origin of the noddle draw instance. Set it to your own origin when self-hosting.

environmentVariables.name: NODDLE_AGENT_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Display name on the agent's comments and version snapshots (max 40 chars).

environmentVariables.name: NODDLE_AI_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional AI provider key, sent only to NODDLE_BASE_URL per call and never stored.
